_comment: Organisation names are PLAIN STRINGS, never localized objects, so no fallback path can produce a translated or shortened form of a legal name. Rows with publish:false or tier:'C' never reach the page, lib/profile-content.ts filters them before render.

current._comment_dates: Intake form section 4: 'منصب حالي, تاريخ البداية يُزوَّد لاحقًا'. Current post, start date to follow. An empty startYear renders 'Start year to be confirmed' rather than a guess.

current._comment: Intake form section 1: 'شريكة مساهمة في مشروعين تجاريين قائمين (الأسماء والتفاصيل تُزوَّد لاحقًا وتُعتمد قبل النشر)', partner in two established commercial ventures, names and details to be supplied and approved BEFORE publication. publish:false holds both rows back; flip to true only once the names are recorded in writing. Naming them now is exactly the fabrication the gate exists to prevent.

_comment_previous: No previous positions were supplied at intake. An empty array is a deliberate blank, not an omission, the section hides itself.
